items.title: Add pre-DONE merge hazard guidance
items.context: Detect and explain untracked-overwrite, branch divergence, generated metadata, and unrelated dirty-file hazards before DONE state becomes confusing. Print exact paths and safe next steps, but do not auto-resolve conflicts or stash user work.
items.userSees: done_prepare prints "merge hazard: untracked file would be overwritten" with the exact path and "preserve or move the file, then rerun done_prepare".

happy.desc: A fixture with an untracked-overwrite hazard reports the exact path and blocks before ambiguous DONE recovery.

edge.desc: A normal no-hazard story proceeds through the existing done_prepare flow unchanged except for clearer status text.

adversarial.desc: The command never stashes, deletes, commits, or overwrites unrelated user files during hazard reporting.

verificationEvidence.note: assertUntrackedOverwriteHazard: BLOCKED with exact path (merge hazard: untracked file would be overwritten: notes/main-only.txt) plus safe next step before any DONE recovery; assertModifiedTrackedPathExactness proves first-row modified paths keep exact form after the porcelain trim fix.

assertMetadataCommitNoRebindAndAutoCloseExit second run: a no-hazard story flows through the existing done_prepare steps to DONE prepare: PASS with no merge-hazard or dirty-classification sections, only clearer status text.

items.title: Explain repeated done_prepare runs and metadata deltas
items.context: When a previous run generated metadata, merged main, changed material, or refreshed evidence, the next run should summarize the delta and explain why rerun is required or why validation can be skipped if fresh.
items.userSees: A repeated run prints "done_prepare re-run reason:" followed by entries such as "previous run wrote done-required-evidence.json" and "review assurance must bind to the current material".

happy.desc: A fixture with generated metadata on the previous run prints a clear rerun reason and next action.

edge.desc: Hash-excluded generated metadata does not force review rebinding, while hash-included metadata warns about required rebinding or is proven not to loop.

adversarial.desc: The guidance never suggests committing unrelated dirty files or self-attesting reviewer/host evidence.

items.title: Prove done_prepare dryRun and generated-file ownership are safe
items.context: Add smoke coverage proving done_prepare --dryRun changes no git state, evidence files, lifecycle metadata, process events, review artifacts, or gate-participating timestamps. Generated-file guidance must identify files produced by the current run.
items.userSees: The smoke prints "done_prepare merge/rerun smoke PASS" and dryRun output says "dryRun: no files will be written" while git/story metadata remains unchanged.

happy.desc: done_prepare --dryRun leaves git status and story metadata byte-identical in the fixture.

edge.desc: Generated-file guidance distinguishes current-run files from pre-existing dirty lifecycle metadata.

adversarial.desc: dryRun cannot write evidence, process events, review artifacts, or timestamps consumed by gates.
